title: Stephanie Bice addresses immigration policy, Epstein investigation transparency, and food prices - OKC Standard
text:
Rep. Stephanie Bice, who represents Oklahoma’s 5th district in the U.S. Congress, recently used her social media platform to comment on national security, government transparency, and consumer prices.
On November 17, 2025, Bice criticized federal immigration policy in a post stating: “A wanted terrorist and criminal illegal alien was released into the U.S. under the Biden administration. He then received work authorization and a commercial drivers license in Pennsylvania. This should never have been allowed to happen.”
The following day, November 18, 2025, Bice addressed public interest in ongoing investigations related to Jeffrey Epstein’s associates and activities. She wrote: “I will support the release of the Epstein files just as I supported the more comprehensive review currently ongoing in the @GOPoversight Committee. As I have said in numerous townhalls and with countless reporters, I want full transparency for the American people but also want”
On November 19, 2025, Bice commented on consumer costs for Thanksgiving meals by referencing data from an agricultural organization: “.@FarmBureau reports that Thanksgiving meal prices are down five percent from 2024. After hitting a record high in 2022, it is great to see lower prices once again.”
Stephanie Bice has represented Oklahoma’s 5th District since 2021 after replacing Kendra Horn. Prior to her tenure in Congress, she served in the Oklahoma Senate from 2014 to 2020. Born in Oklahoma City in 1973 and currently residing there, Bice graduated from Oklahoma State University–Stillwater with a Bachelor of Science degree in 1995.
